device.name: CoppeliaSim UR5 reaching environment v3 (legacy Gym)

facts.text: Simulation/README.MD names CoppeliaSim_UR5_gym_v0.py and CoppeliaSim_UR5_gym_v3.py as the environment code and says its format is gym format
The v3 entry class is CoppeliaSim_UR5_gym_v3, a subclass of CoppeliaSim_UR5_base and gym.Env
The action_low and action_high lists are [-5, -5, -5, -5] and [5, 5, 5, 5]
action_space is spaces.Box(low_action, high_action, dtype=np.float32)
The observation space is a Box of shape (128,128,3) with float32 values from 0 to 255
The reset target joint vector init_joints_pos is [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, pi/2, 0.0]
DELTA is pi/180.0 rad and MOVE_UNIT is 2*DELTA
apply_action multiplies action[0..3] by MOVE_UNIT and adds it to current_joint_pos[0..3]
REACH_THRESHOLD is 0.08
check_done reports step_end_status 1 when current_dis is at most REACH_THRESHOLD
check_done reports step_end_status 2 when the tip leaves the safety box
The joint limits are joint1 [-pi, pi], joint2 [-pi/2, pi/2], joint3 [-pi, pi] and joint4 [-pi, pi]
check_done reports step_end_status 2 when a joint reaches its limit
STAY_THRESHOLD is 0.1 and STAY_FLAG is 30
check_stay returns step_end_status 3 when at least 25 of the last 30 tip positions are within STAY_THRESHOLD of the current one
step rewards (last_dis - current_dis) * 100, pays -150 when step_end_status is 2, and adds 2000 / tra_num_step on reaching the target
target_range_low is [-0.343, -0.737, 0.685] and target_range_high is [0.041, -0.003, 0.685]
random_gen_one_target_pos draws the next target uniformly between target_range_low and target_range_high
seed() fills self.np_random with gym.utils.seeding.np_random
step returns the legacy four-value tuple (next_state, reward, done, info)
get_state returns the Side_camera1 image from the simulator
MAX_STEP is 200
reset sets num_step to 0 and tra_num_step to -1
check_done compares num_step with MAX_STEP
apply_action increments tra_num_step, not num_step
The environment opens CoppeliaSim's legacy remote API at 127.0.0.1:19998 before it can run
The recorded environment pins gym 0.18.3, the legacy four-value step API

determinism.notes: the package's fake draws its target from Python's random.Random(seed), so a seed repeats its trajectory; the upstream reset draws the target from numpy's global np.random.uniform and its seed() only fills self.np_random, so the two do not share a seed stream

gaps: the fake is kinematic: it moves the four actuated joints by action * MOVE_UNIT and reads a toy tip position; it models no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuator, sensor, noise or camera rendering
the fake returns a 4x4x3 test image, while the upstream observation_space is 128x128x3 (Simulation/CoppeliaSim_UR5_gym_v3.py:78-89); the real image size is not carried by the fake
no CoppeliaSim scene is loaded and the legacy remote API at 127.0.0.1:19998 is not contacted, so the .ttt scene, the real robot part and the simulator's own clock are not exercised
the clone states no fixed physics timestep; timestep_ms is 0 because CoppeliaSim owns the clock
snapshot restore is not offered: get_state returns only the Side_camera1 image and there is no set_state

the upstream v3 resets itself on reaching, on a safety-box or joint-limit event and on a detected stay, and its num_step is never incremented, so MAX_STEP 200 is unreachable; the fake mirrors those transitions without terminating
the fake guards the upstream's 2000 / tra_num_step division when a reach is detected on a first step; with its toy tip position the reach branch never fires
the fake was never compared with the upstream environment or a real UR5

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
